t: Two Pistols Found Discarded In Room 429 Of The Woo Koong Hotel

pages.en:
D & Sp. Branch
Minc. 563/N
Loua
-40
26 (签)
Two pistols found concealed in room 429 of the Woo Kong
Hotel, 152 Fokien Road.
I. I. Suh:ff.

Sir,
At 1.30 p.m. on 22-8-40 Supt. You Ah Kung, Senior
Detective Loua Station received telephone message
from ne n mei Tsau Tsang mou (周正甫) private detective
employed at the Woo Kong hotel 15 Fokien Road, who
reported that at about 1.15 p.m. same date a coolie
named Kong Tao Sung (江道生) 26, native of Tungchow,
employed at this hotel whilst cleaning room 429 on
the 3rd floor of the hotel found two pistols concealed
under the steam-radiator.

Supt. You Ah Kung on having received this message
telephoned to this Station. C.D.F. 130 and the under-
signed attended and one 7.65 mauer No. 385077 with
one round in the breech and one magazine with six rounds
of ammunition and one "Dreyse" 0.25 pistol with one
round of ammunition in the breech and one magazine
with 4 rounds of ammunition were handed over to the
detectives.

Both pistols are in rusty condition and could
not be unloaded.

Enquiries at the hotel ascertained that room
429 had been vacated at 12 noon on 22-8-40 by the
named Wu Ya Yu (楊亞夫) age 30, native of Hankow,
merchant, who engaged this room on 17-8-40. He is well
known customer at this hotel and it appears to be that
the two pistols in question might have been concealed
under the steam-radiator sometime previous to which
indicates the rusted condition of the weapons.

DATE 26/8/40
pages.zh:
政治部及特别分部
备忘录 563/N
娄阿（Loua）
-40
26 （签名）
在福建路152号吴宫酒店（Woo Kong Hotel）429房间内发现藏匿的两支手枪。
I. I. Suh：附议。

先生，
1940年8月22日下午1时30分，老闸捕房高级探员尤阿公（You Ah Kung）巡官接到福建路152号吴宫酒店雇用的私人侦探周正甫（Tsau Tsang mou）的电话报告，称同日约下午1时15分，该酒店一名名叫江道生（Kong Tao Sung）、26岁、通州籍的苦力，在清扫酒店三楼429房间时，发现两支手枪藏匿于蒸汽散热器下。

尤阿公巡官接到此消息后，致电本捕房。刑事侦缉队第130号警员及本人随即前往现场，一支7.65毫米毛瑟手枪（编号385077），枪膛内有一发子弹，弹匣内有六发子弹；以及一支“德莱赛”（Dreyse）0.25口径手枪，枪膛内有一发子弹，弹匣内有四发子弹，均移交给了探员。

两支手枪均呈锈蚀状态，无法退弹。

经在酒店查询得知，429房间已于1940年8月22日中午12时由名为杨亚夫（Wu Ya Yu）、30岁、汉口籍、商人的住客退房，该人于1940年8月17日入住此房间。他是该酒店的熟客，看来这两支涉案手枪可能是在此前某个时间藏匿于蒸汽散热器下的，这也解释了武器生锈的状况。

日期 1940年8月26日
